definitions.gloss: weather map; weather chart; synoptic chart
definitions.explanation: A map showing atmospheric conditions over a region at a given time, including pressure systems, fronts, and other meteorological data.

examples.japanese: {天気図|てんきず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look at the weather map.

examples.japanese: {天気図|てんきず}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧。
examples.english: To read the typhoon's path from the weather map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{天気図|てんきず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to read weather maps in science class.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧ (weather) + ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (chart, map). A standard term used in meteorology, weather forecasting, and school education.

USAGE:
Weather maps are a fixture of Japanese TV weather forecasts and are taught in middle school science classes. Japanese weather maps use {等圧線|とうあつせん} (isobars), ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧ (fronts), and symbols for ⟦{高気圧|こうきあつ}→高気圧：14808_koukiatsu⟧ (high pressure) and ⟦{低気圧|ていきあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧ (low pressure). Reading weather maps is part of the standard school curriculum.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天気図|てんきず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ — to read a weather map
- {天気図|てんきず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ — how to read a weather map
- ⟦{地上|ちじょう}→地上：12108_chijou⟧{天気図|てんきず} — surface weather map
- {天気図|てんきず}⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧ — weather map symbols

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧ — weather forecast (the prediction, not the map)
- {気象図|きしょうず} — meteorological chart (more technical synonym)
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧ — weather (the condition itself)
